note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors. Every division was filled by a single nomination, so there was no poll; no nomination was received for Glenshesk and the retiring member was re-elected. Filed on the rural districts' polling day, Thursday 5 June 1930 (queue nominal 29 May). Sole nomination; returned unopposed. Returned unopposed.
